description: This file is the EditView script for the 'Invoice' module in a vtigerCRM-based system. It manages the creation and editing of invoice records, handling conversions from quotes, sales orders, and other sources. It includes data retrieval, form population, and view rendering logic, relying on various modules and utility functions to assemble the invoice editing interface.
